question.text: PMS (Portfolio Management Services) and Category III AIF differ on:

answer.text: Pooling: AIFs pool investor capital; PMS operates per individual account

explanation.text: The Logic: Key distinction: PMS does NOT pool — each client has a separate portfolio. Cat III AIFs pool capital in a single vehicle. The Trap: Other options either overlap both or are incorrect. Cross-Exam Context: PMS requires Rs. 50 lakh min; Cat III requires Rs. 1 crore. Distributor's Pro-Tip: For portfolio-customization needs, PMS is better; for pooled strategies, Cat III.
